settings.title: no workshop needed
settings.body: Hand tools and technical drawings — no welding, no factory. We bring everything; you bring the class and a room with tables.

settings.title: no engineering background needed
settings.body: Teachers join in whether or not they've held a saw. Session plans, risk assessments and the run-of-day arrive before we do.

settings.title: accredited when you want it
settings.body: The balance bike build is available as an OCN London Level 2 course — Introduction to Product Design & Manufacture (Bamboo Balance Bike), centre course 1131207 — with portfolio evidence collected session by session.

settings.title: priced by cohort and format
settings.body: Each pathway is quoted on cohort size and delivery format, and we help schools find funding routes before the budget conversation starts.

settings.title: speaker session
settings.lede: A hands-on introduction to bamboo, sustainable design and practical engineering.
settings.body: A low-cost, low-barrier, light-touch session with an immediate, tangible outcome. Students explore regenerative materials, tools and product design through an accessible making activity — creating something themselves while discovering where STEM, sustainability and engineering can lead.
settings.pricing: based on cohort size and delivery format
settings.progression: A low-barrier introduction that can lead into pathways 02–05.
settings.image_alt: Marking up a bamboo tube for the speaker build on the workbench
settings.seen_label: the Engineering Club talk — a free public lecture on bamboo bike design

settings.title: balance bike build
settings.lede: Build a real bamboo balance bike — practical engineering, teamwork and accredited learning.
settings.body: Students work in small teams using hand tools and technical drawings to build a working balance bike, developing practical skills in product design, manufacturing and problem-solving.
settings.pricing: based on cohort size and number of bikes built
settings.accred: OCN London Level 2 available — Introduction to Product Design & Manufacture (Bamboo Balance Bike), centre course 1131207.
settings.progression: An accessible route into engineering, technical learning and further skills development.
settings.image_alt: A part-built bamboo balance bike with wheels and components laid out on the build drawing
settings.seen_label: Project Zero, Waltham Forest — 27 young people, 27 working bikes

settings.title: enterprise
settings.lede: From idea to pitch — practical enterprise learning built around a real product.
settings.body: Students create their own bike business, developing a brand, product and commercial idea while building skills in teamwork, budgeting, marketing, problem-solving and pitching.
settings.pricing: based on cohort size and delivery format
settings.progression: Builds confidence, commercial awareness and pathways into further learning, employment and entrepreneurship.
settings.image_alt: Hands fitting a handlebar grip onto a bamboo balance bike during the build
settings.seen_label: Digital Futures — sustainability and enterprise, twice in a day

settings.title: e-bike build
settings.lede: Electric drivetrains on bamboo frames — hands-on STEM, sustainable transport and future technology.
settings.body: Students work with motors, batteries, sensors and controllers to assemble and test an e-bike, applying science, engineering and maths through a practical challenge.
settings.pricing: based on cohort size and number of bikes built
settings.progression: Pathways into sustainable transport, manufacturing, construction and composites.
settings.tags: Hands-on STEM, Future mobility, Active travel
settings.image_alt: A bamboo electric cargo bike built by UCL Masters students, on the road
settings.seen_label: UCL Masters engineers — bamboo under load, up to an e-cargo bike

settings.title: ai & 3d printing
settings.lede: From digital design to physical parts — practical skills in AI, CAD and 3D printing.
settings.body: Students use AI-assisted design, CAD and 3D printing to develop and manufacture real bike components, exploring digital fabrication, materials and modern engineering through a practical challenge.
settings.pricing: based on cohort size and delivery format
settings.progression: Pathways into engineering, digital manufacturing, apprenticeships and technical careers.
settings.tags: AI & digital design, 3D printing, Future skills
settings.image_alt: A glossy black composite lug joining bamboo tubes, freshly finished
settings.seen_label: the world’s first 3D-printed bamboo bike, with Oxford Brookes

settings.title: springboard into adulthood
settings.body: Accredited training with work-ready skills and direct pathways to opportunities.

settings.title: education pathway
settings.body: Two OCN London Level 2 courses, curriculum projects and portfolio evidence for academic progression.

settings.title: active travel & decarbonisation
settings.body: Personal builds that ride home — accessible, zero-emission mobility with a story worth telling.

settings.title: inclusion
settings.body: Team-based learning with adapted builds, so every young person can take part and finish something real.

settings.title: green skills
settings.body: Environmental STEM training delivering transferable skills for green careers.

settings.hero_image_alt: Bamboo frame lugs laid out on the workbench, mid stop-motion build
settings.hero_lede: Hands-on STEM and accredited learning through building real bamboo bikes — in schools, colleges and youth settings. Five pathways, from a single lesson to a multi-day programme.
settings.sites_list: as seen at — Design Museum, London · Musée du Luxembourg, Paris · London Design Festival · Grand Designs Live · UK Bamboo Summit, Coventry
settings.inst_title: built in schools, colleges and universities.
settings.inst_unis: UCL · Aston University · Imperial College London · King’s College London · London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine · London South Bank University · Oxford Brookes University · University of Surrey · University of Manchester · Swansea University · University of Warwick · Coventry University · University of Exeter · Nottingham Trent University
settings.inst_schools: Southbank UTC · Bradfield College · Kingswood School, Bath · The Judd School · Harborne Academy · James Brindley School, Birmingham · Reed’s School, Cobham · Verulam School, St Albans · Bearsden Academy, Glasgow · BMET College, Birmingham
settings.inst_note: Every institution named is on record — workshops delivered, kits supplied or builds run together, 2014 to today. Some sessions are delivered with partners, including We Job Box.
settings.sch_card_body: Five pathways from a single lesson to a multi-day programme — teacher-friendly, hand tools only, OCN London Level 2 accredited when you build up.
settings.comc_card_body: The same five pathways in youth settings — a free taster talk to accredited builds and enterprise skills. Delivered with Project Zero in Waltham Forest; piloted with Camden.
settings.mat_lede: Bamboo is harvested in years, not decades — no welding, no factory. A frame under load in a university test rig is the whole argument in forty seconds.
settings.mat1_t: Regrows in three to five years
settings.mat1_b: sustainable design that students can hold, cut and shape.
settings.mat2_b: a hacksaw, files, sandpaper and a tape measure make real engineering accessible.
settings.mat3_b: engineering, design and sustainability in the same hour.
settings.mat_range: bamboo speaker, balance bike, road & gravel frame, e-bike, 3D-printed lugs, bespoke frames
settings.pw_lede: Start with a talk, climb to digital fabrication. One bench, one set of skills, five ways to book it — each sheet carries the cohort, the format, the duration and what gets built.
settings.pw_note: One sheet open at a time. Every pathway is quoted on cohort size and delivery format; a taster talk in your venue is free.
settings.sch_lede: Every pathway fits a school format — a single period, a double, a half day, a drop-down day or a multi-day programme. Teachers stay in the room; we bring the tools, the material and the plan.
settings.tt_foot: From a single lesson to a full STEM day or an intensive programme.
settings.com_lede: Start with a free taster talk in your venue and go as far as your young people want — the same five pathways, built for youth settings.
settings.com_audiences: councils, violence reduction units, youth hubs, PRUs, community trusts
settings.com_proof: Delivered with Project Zero and Waltham Forest College — 27 young people built working bamboo bikes, and their ratings regularly reached 9–10 out of 10. Piloted with Camden at Euston Skills Centre.
settings.com_proof_label: read the Project Zero case study
settings.out_lede: What a young person leaves with — and what a school, council or funder can evidence.
settings.recog_c: Kevin McCloud's Green Heroes, Grand Designs Live 2018
settings.cta_lede: A short call is all it takes to start. Tell us who you are and what you'd like to run, and we'll come back with a scoped plan and budget you can take to your governor, head or funder.
settings.cs_title: the same bench, in very different rooms.
settings.cs_lede: Real deliveries — schools, universities, youth services and community halls — each with its own photographs, taken in the room.
